name: Name
exportNoFilesWritten: No files were written. Check that the selected routes have geometry data.
exportNoGeom: No geometry data available for export.
deleteConfirmationBody: Are you sure you want to delete %s route(s)? This cannot be undone.
regexInfo: A regular expression (regex) is a pattern that describes sets of strings. For example, the pattern "^Mount" matches titles starting with "Mount". Use regexr.com to learn and test patterns.
hintNumericFilter: Filter routes by minimum and/or maximum values for this column. Leave a field empty to skip that side of the range.
hintDateFilter: Filter routes by a date range. Select start and/or end dates — leave either empty to leave that side unbounded.
hintStringFilter: Choose an operator to match against the title and enter a value. "regex" uses regular expressions for advanced pattern matching.
hintName: Give the route a descriptive name to help you identify it later. The name is shown in the route list and on the map.
hintRouting: Use this route for turn-by-turn navigation. The route's geometry is loaded into the routing engine and the map pans to its center.
hintStats: View aggregated statistics for this route including length, elevation gain and loss, and minimum and maximum elevation.
hintExport: Export this route to a file in GPX, KML, or GeoJSON format. Files are saved to the Straymap export directory.
hintToggleOnMap: Show or hide this route on the map. Hidden routes stay in your library but are not drawn on the map, keeping it clean while you work with other routes.
hintFlyTo: Pan and zoom the map to fit the entire route within view. Useful for quickly locating a route on the map.
hintDelete: Permanently delete this route from your library and remove it from the map. This cannot be undone.
regexUnavailable: REGEXP is not available. Regex filters will not work.
importHint: Select a GPX, KML, or GeoJSON file containing tracks or routes. Supported extensions: {{extensions}}
importNoFeatures: No tracks or routes found in the file.
importDirNoFiles: No supported files found in this directory.
importMergeMode: Merge all tracks into a single route
